## 📌 Description

Please provide a clear and concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the problem they solve or feature they implement.

---

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] ✨ `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] 🐛 `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] ♻️ `refactor`: Code refactoring without changing functionality
- [ ] 📝 `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] 🧪 `test`: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] 🎨 `style`: Code style / formatting changes
- [ ] ⚡ `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔧 `chore`: Build system, configuration, or dependency updates

- [ ] TypeScript types check cleanly with no errors (`bun run check-types`).
- [ ] No `any` types were introduced without justification.
- [ ] If changing backend API routes, Zod schemas and Scalar docs are updated and verified.
- [ ] Any relevant documentation has been updated.
